title: Music made of several sound clips plays without dropping out where they meet
goal: In an exported video whose music is made of short sound clips laid end to end, the sound went silent for most of a second just before one set of clips handed over to the next, although the sound files themselves have no silence. Sound clips that meet must play straight through, in playback and in export.
notes:
User, 2026-11-26: "I tried making one this morning. it was boring, the transitions were a bit buggy (e.g. 3d transitions wouldn't fade in and would immediately cover content, text would be clipped in weird spots, the transitions were dull). I don't see anything queued or done with improving the features and quality to make amazing sizzle reels (with a bunch of music presets that can create epic build ups and intensity and draw emotion)." 

The source .caf loops have no silence (silencedetect finds none). The 14 to 17 s video clip had set_speed 200 applied before export, which shortened it to 15.5; sound tracks were not touched. Related, not the same: the-sound-of-the-whole-reference-edit-plays-with (p2, playback dropouts measured once a second); if that task's measuring tool is built, reuse it.
acceptance: Reproduced first: the edit in queue/audits/2026-11-26-sizzle-intake/README.md (Apple Loops Mega Anthem Synth 2 at 0, 7.5, 15 and Four Four Beat at 7.5, 11.25, 15, each on its own audio track as Add Media at Playhead puts them) exported to MP4: ffmpeg silencedetect at -45 dB finds 14.36 to 15.04 s silent. Find which clip stops early and why (a sound clip's length rounded, an audio read ending short at a later track's start, a speed change on the video clip at 14 s shifting sound, or the mix itself) and write the cause in the audit with evidence.

Bar: in export and in playback (sample the output the way the-sound-of-the-whole-reference-edit-plays-with measures it), no stretch over 10 ms quieter than -45 dB anywhere a sound clip is playing, across clips that meet on one track and on different tracks, at the edit's own times and after a speed change elsewhere in the edit.
A test that fails on today's code. Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not.

log.note: Re-checked on Photonz Dev 0.25.0 (today's main) on 2026-11-26: the first reel ran on the user's 0.23.0 app. Still reproduces, same numbers: see queue/audits/2026-11-26-sizzle-intake/on-0.25-dev/ and the README's Correction section.

Cause found and reproduced: AudioMixdown.composition applied a piece's speed with composition.scaleTimeRange, which scales EVERY track over that stretch. The reel's 14 s clip (a screen recording with a sound track) at 200% squeezed the synth and beat beside it into half the time, so they ran out ~0.6 s early and the loops at 15 s came in on time after a hole. Repro with the real Apple Loops + a sound-bearing recording at 200% from 13.72 s through AudioMixdown.write: silencedetect -45 dB 14.380875 to 14.999937 (reel export: 14.358958 to 15.043938; the extra 40 ms either end is the 720p re-encode, which also shows 0 to 44 ms silent at the start that the mix itself does not have). After the fix (track.scaleTimeRange) the same repro finds no silence at all over 22.55 s. A slowed clip did the opposite: stretched every track, pushing music past the next loop, which was then dropped (file 1.09 s short).

Second cause, found by the new walk: in playback, the player sets each clip's fader from the picture's clock on a 30 Hz tick and held a voice with nothing sounding at 0, so a clip starting mid-play (a different layer meeting another on a track) was muted until the first tick after its start plus output latency: 18 to 26 ms dropout at the 5 s meeting, 3 of 3 runs. Pieces of one clip meeting (same layer) had no gap. Fix: AudioVoiceLevels (PhotonzCore) turns a voice up to its next piece's opening level up to 250 ms ahead. Walk 3 of 3 clean after.

Verified: SoundClipsMeetExportTests 3 of 4 failed before the AudioMixdown fix (5.025 to 6.0 s silent, a file 1.09 s short after a slow-down), all pass after; the reel's real loops through AudioMixdown.write: 14.381 to 15.000 s silent before, none after. AudioVoiceLevelsTests, SoundDropoutsTests, expectSoundUnbroken parse test added. 11 nearby sound walks ok (cross-fade, ducks, music bed, playback speed, speed stretch, transition sound, transport volume, title sounds). Scripts/test.sh green. Rough items: the 0 s and 15.04 s re-encode silence is not the app (logged in the audit, no task). Left rough: a fade inside a piece still follows the picture-clock tick, a few ms behind; nobody has heard it, so it did not earn a task. The p2 the-sound-of-the-whole-reference-edit-plays-with can reuse expectSoundUnbroken / SoundDropouts as its measure.

Two causes fixed. Export: a clip's speed scaled the whole mix instead of its own track (AudioMixdown), so music beside the reel's 2x clip ran out 0.6 s early. Playback: a clip starting mid-play was muted until the next 30 Hz fader tick, an 18 to 26 ms gap where clips meet (AudioVoiceLevels). Verified: the reel's loops through the export, 14.38 to 15.00 s silent before and none after; SoundClipsMeetExportTests failed before and pass after; the new walk failed 3 of 3 before and passes 3 of 3 after; 11 nearby sound walks ok; test.sh green.
